heads.en: Prologue on the Commendation of Holy Scripture

headnotes.la: etc. [n: (Eccli. XXIII)]. Secundum quod dicit beatus Greg. Homil. 35 Evangeliorum
headnotes.en: etc. [n: (Eccli. XXIII)]. According to what blessed Gregory says in Homily 35 on the Gospels

headnotes.la: …lativae ordinantur ad felicitatem contemplativam, loquendo de contemplatione quae potest haberi in vita praesenti, et per viam naturae, quae dependet ex phantasmate. Unde dicitur tertio de anima, quod
headnotes.en: …contemplative happiness, speaking of the contemplation that can be had in the present life, and by way of nature, which depends upon the phantasm. Hence it is said in the third book *On the Soul* that

headnotes.la: Et de tali speculatione dicitur ibidem, quod
headnotes.en: And of such contemplation it is said in the same place that

headnotes.la: Sacra autem Scriptura ordinatur ad felicitatem vitae futurae, quam philosophi nesciverunt, secundum quod dicit beatus Hieronymus in epistola ad Paulinum de omnibus sacrae Scripturae libris
headnotes.en: …Holy Scripture is ordered to the happiness of the life to come, which the philosophers did not know, according to what blessed Jerome says in the epistle to Paulinus on all the books of Holy Scripture

headnotes.la: …edunt per investigationem rationis humanae. In quo quidem processis licet non sit error quantum ad cognitionem primorum principiorum, quae sunt per se nota [n: (secundum quod dicitur secundo Metaphys.
headnotes.en: …an reason. In which [sic: *processis*] process, although there is no error as regards the knowledge of first principles, which are known through themselves [n: (secundum quod dicitur secundo Metaphys.

headnotes.la: …ncipiis longinquas. Unde et in tali processu omnes philosophi, innitentes tantum humanae investigationi, inveniuntur errasse, et ideo de singulari eminentia hujus scientiae dicitur Deuteronomii quarto
headnotes.en: …uch a process all the philosophers, relying only on human investigation, are found to have erred; and therefore of the singular eminence of this science it is said in the fourth chapter of Deuteronomy

headnotes.la: …r ipsam ipse speculans seu contemplans feratur in amorem ipsius objecti cogniti, scilicet Dei, ipsum super se, et super omnia diligendo. Et propter hoc Salvator Matthaei vigesimo secundo dicit quod in
headnotes.en: …beholds may be borne into love of the very object known, namely God, loving him above himself and above all things. And for this reason the Saviour says in the twenty-second chapter of Matthew that on

headnotes.la: et Apostolus primae ad Timotheum I
headnotes.en: and the Apostle, in the first to Timothy, I

headnotes.la: Et quia philosophi suo sensui innitentes, hunc finem non attenderunt, ideo erraverunt; propter quod eorum sapientia, *insipientia* nominatur, ad Romanos I
headnotes.en: And because the philosophers, relying on their own sense, did not attend to this end, therefore they erred; for which reason their wisdom is named *foolishness*, in Romans I

headnotes.la: …xcellit alias inquantum est de subjecto nobiliori, sed etiam inquantum procedit modo certiori, videlicet per divinam revelationem, cui non potest subesse falsum: ideo subditur in auctoritate praemissa
headnotes.en: …ler subject, but also inasmuch as it proceeds in a more certain mode, namely through divine revelation, under which there can be nothing false: therefore there is added in the authority set down above

headnotes.la: …ur, verum judicatur.; quod autem ei repugnat, falsum simpliciter reputatur: et ideo sacra Scriptura non solum vocatur sapientia, sed etiam cum hoc intellectus; unde dicitur Ecclesiastici decimo quinto
headnotes.en: …ugnant to it is reckoned simply false: and therefore Holy Scripture is called not only wisdom, but also, together with this, understanding; whence it is said in the fifteenth chapter of Ecclesiasticus

headnotes.la: Et Colossensium primo
headnotes.en: And in the first of Colossians

headnotes.la: …ia est quodammodo considerativa omnium. In quo apparet ejus continentia generalis, quae notatur in verbo primitus praeassumpto, cum dicitur, *omnia;* de quo potest exponi quod dicitur Sapientiae primo
headnotes.en: …ich appears its general comprehensiveness, which is marked in the word first taken up at the start, when it is said, *all things;* of which may be expounded what is said in the first chapter of Wisdom

headnotes.la: …men sacrae Scripturae (quae licet dividantur in plures libros partiales, tamen rediguntur in unum volumen quod Biblia appellatur) continet omnia, quia haec scientia est quodammodo omnium considerativa
headnotes.en: … are divided into several partial books, are nevertheless gathered into one volume which is called the Bible), contains all things, because this science is in a certain way considerative of all things

headnotes.la: de proprietate vocis est, quod sit verbi significativa, et proprium est sacrae Scripturae quod sit divini Verbi expressiva, secundum quod manifeste habetur Joannis primo
headnotes.en: … property of the voice that it be significative of a word, and it is proper to Holy Scripture that it be expressive of the divine Word, according to what is manifestly had in the first chapter of John

headnotes.la: …tionem et dilectionem Dei per veram fidem charitate formatam, ad quam consideratio hujus scientiae ordinatur, ut praedictum est. Et hoc est quod dicit Augustinus decimo quarto de Trinitate, cap. primo
headnotes.en: …od through true faith formed by charity, to which the consideration of this science is ordered, as was said before. And this is what Augustine says in the fourteenth book *On the Trinity,* chapter one

headnotes.la: Unde et Joannis decimo sexto Salvator loquens de Spiritu sancto, cujus revelatione tradita est haec Scriptura dicit
headnotes.en: Hence also in the sixteenth chapter of John the Saviour, speaking of the Holy Spirit, by whose revelation this Scripture was handed down, says

headnotes.la: Glossa
headnotes.en: the Gloss

headnotes.la: …a, in qua relucent omnes veritates, *liber* vocatur: in quo libro leguntur sancti apostoli et prophetae qui hanc scientiam tradiderunt. Et hoc est quod dicit glossa super illud Isaiae trigesimo octavo
headnotes.en: … the holy apostles and prophets who handed down this science [cj: *leguntur*, "are read"; read *legunt*, "read"]. And this is what the gloss says on that passage of the thirty-eighth chapter of Isaiah

headnotes.la: etc. Glossa
headnotes.en: etc. The Gloss

headnotes.la: …e, quae primo fuit fundata a Melchisedech, postea per Salomonem dilata et fortificata. Secundum sensum vero moralem significat animam fidelem, secundum quem sensum dicitur Isaiae quinquagesimo secundo
headnotes.en: …chisedech, afterwards spread abroad and fortified by Solomon. But according to the moral sense it signifies the faithful soul, according to which sense it is said in the fifty-second chapter of Isaiah

headnotes.la: etc. Secundum sensum vero allegoricum significat Ecclesiam militantem, secundum quem dicitur Apocalypsis vigesimo primo
headnotes.en: etc. But according to the allegorical sense it signifies the Church militant, according to which it is said in the twenty-first chapter of the Apocalypse

headnotes.la: Secundum Vero sensum anagogicum significat Ecclesiam triumphantem, secundum quod dicitur Galatarum quarto
headnotes.en: But according to the anagogical sense it signifies the Church triumphant, according to what is said in the fourth chapter of Galatians

headnotes.la: …sicut positum est exemplum in una dictione, ita posset poni in una oratione: et sicut in una, ita et in aliis. Igitur de isto libro sub una littera continente plures sensus, dicitur Ezechielis secundo
headnotes.en: …rth in one word, so it could be set forth in one sentence: and as in one, so also in others. Of this book, then, containing several senses under one letter, it is said in the second chapter of Ezekiel

headnotes.la: Et Apocalypsis
headnotes.en: And in Apocalypse

headnotes.la: Et Apocalypsis « quinto
headnotes.en: And in Apocalypse « five

headnotes.la: …i ista, ducit immediate ad vitam beatam quae sola est vita simpliciter, quia mortem nescit. Ideo Salvator, Joannis quinto, loquens de efficacia hujus sacrae Scripturae, dicebat Judaeis in lege peritis
headnotes.en: …d life, which alone is life simply, because it knows no death. Therefore the Saviour, in the fifth chapter of John, speaking of the efficacy of this Holy Scripture, said to the Jews learned in the law

headnotes.la: …is aeternae, quae est finis hujus scientiae, quam sine dubio consequuntur eam sane intelligentes, et secundum sanum ipsius intellectum pie viventes, secundum quod dicitur Ecclesiastici vigesimo quarto
headnotes.en: …his science, which those without doubt attain who understand it soundly, and live piously according to its sound understanding, according to what is said in the twenty-fourth chapter of Ecclesiasticus
